title: Publisher file (publisher-data/<publisher-slug>/<stem>.json)
description: Facts a publisher adds where AppSource falls short. Supplements only, never a second description. Every field except appName feeds matching, so every value must be checkable.

appId.description: AppSource ID of this app. Do not change.

appName.description: For reading only. Kept in sync by the build. Do not change.

countries.description: Extra countries the app supports, beyond what AppSource states. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase. Example: NO

languages.description: Extra UI languages, beyond what AppSource states. ISO 639-1, lowercase, optional region. Example: nb, de-CH

extends.description: AppSource IDs of apps this app is a genuine extension of. Implies the customer has that app.

worksWellWith.description: AppSource IDs of apps this app is known to work well alongside. Softer than extends.

showLogo.description: Consent to show your logo. Default false.

logoUrl.description: Your own hosted logo, https. Shown only when showLogo is true.
